title: FHIR DiagnosticReport submission 504 timeout
description: Intermittent 504 errors when POSTing DiagnosticReport bundles to RMH FHIR server. Appears related to large result sets with >5 observations.

title: HL7 interface down - ORM messages rejected
description: Charite HL7 interface rejecting ORM^O01 messages with NAK. Error: 'Unknown sending facility'. Possible config change on their side after weekend maintenance.

title: DICOM C-STORE timeouts on CT series
description: Intermittent timeouts when receiving large CT series (>200 slices). Single CR images unaffected. Possible bandwidth constraint.

title: HL7 ADT messages arriving with truncated PID segments
description: 4.2% of ADT^A08 messages from SVH have truncated PID-11 (address) fields. Parser handles gracefully but demographics sync is incomplete.

title: FHIR Observation resource validation warnings
description: GSTT FHIR server returning warnings on Observation.component cardinality. Root cause: their server updated to stricter R4B validation. Fixed by updating bundle format.

title: DICOM SR not appearing in radiologist worklist
description: AI Structured Reports sent to MCR PACS but not populating in reading worklist. Root cause: SR Series Description didn't match their worklist filter. Fixed routing tag.

title: Duplicate ORM orders received during Epic upgrade
description: CCF Epic upgrade caused duplicate ORM^O01 messages for same accession number. De-duplication logic caught 98% but 3 studies were processed twice. Added accession-based idempotency check.
